list now renders two-line default (title+marker / id · assignee · state); --oneline reuses formatListTask verbatim; active lap marked via store.ReadClaim; legacy list assertions migrated onto --oneline; build and full test suite green

Verified improve-cli-ergonomics list formatter diff against origin/main; oneline reuse, claim-reader marker, dynamic indent, done styling, and migrated assertions all checked out; go test and CI-equivalent lint passed.

Added ls as a cobra alias of listCmd and registered ls in isKnownCommand so it dispatches as a built-in (not hook-only); added the 1.7 test matrix covering two-line default, oneline shape, three marker states, ls alias parity, Execute dispatch non-interception, and ls --json-output. go test ./..., go vet, gofmt clean; bin/laps ls matches list byte-for-byte across all flags.

Added internal/cmd/move.go: 'laps move <id> head|tail|after <target>' reorders a TODO lap via store.ComputeInsertOrder, preserving id, advancing updatedAt, emitting the after-done stderr notice, honoring --json-output, and running before/after hooks; registered 'move' in isKnownCommand. build/vet/lint(0 issues)/tests green; full smoke matrix verified.

Added 11 focused move-command tests in internal/cmd/cmd_test.go covering head/tail/after ordering via list --oneline + idxBefore, byte-identical id preservation, every exit-code branch (exit 1: unknown id, done id, self-reference, usage/invalid-position; exit 3: missing after target), after-done fallback to head with the stderr notice asserted, --json-output payload with preserved id, deterministic updatedAt advancement, runMBExecute dispatch through isKnownCommand, and before/after hook context with the affected task id/title. go test ./..., go vet, and gofmt all clean.
Verified improve-cli-ergonomics ls alias/list marker matrix and move command against origin/main and the post-6fc9469 batch; go test passed, golangci-lint v2 was clean, and tasks 2.1-2.7 were ticked.

Added internal/cmd/edit.go (edit <id> --title/--description/--assignee, Changed-gated so empty clears, blank-title error, escaped \n, trims assignee, bumps updatedAt, --json-output {task}, hooks, done-lap stderr warning without reopening) and internal/cmd/assign.go (assign <id> <role> sugar reusing runEdit, blank role clears); registered edit/assign in isKnownCommand. build/vet/gofmt clean, golangci-lint 0 issues, go test ./... green, full smoke matrix verified.

Added full edit/assign test coverage (per-field edits, all exit branches, description clear + escaped \n, assignee trim/clear, assign sugar, done-lap warning preserving IsDone/completedAt, id-only + {task:...} JSON, before/after hook context, Execute dispatch) and extended runMB/runMBExecute to register editCmd/moveCmd/assignCmd flagsets and zero the edit* vars so cmd.Flags().Changed cannot leak between tests; load-bearing regression guard fails without the fix. go test ./... and count=2 ./internal/cmd green; gofmt/vet clean.

Documented ls alias, list two-line default + --oneline, move, edit, and assign in the README command reference; removed edit/move/assign from the reserved/hook-only command-name lists. Verified flags/usage against bin/laps --help for all four commands. VERSION left unchanged (4.2 is a non-action; 0.9.0 bump belongs to add-stints-gating). Committed docs(readme) change + done marker.
Verified improve-cli-ergonomics whole-change diff; tests, lint, and smoke passed; ticked 3.8, 3.9, and 4.1; VERSION unchanged.

Added internal/eventlog: native best-effort JSONL writer appending one schema-complete line per call to .laps/log.jsonl, stamping ts (UTC RFC3339), session (LAPS_SESSION), and default scope=root; 6 focused tests pass and go test ./... is green. Not yet wired into commands.

Fixed init .gitignore scan to append ALL missing entries among {.laps/claim, .laps/log.jsonl} (was breaking at first .laps/claim match, missing log.jsonl) with a message naming entries actually added; registered log and status as built-ins in isKnownCommand. Added regression + both/none/arbitrary-content tests; go test ./... and go vet clean.

store.Claim{lap,file,claimedAt} replaces bare-id claim file: JSON persistence with legacy bare-id read-back (file=selected, claimedAt=null), unknown-field forward-compat, ErrMalformedClaim for corrupt JSON objects, zero-value (Lap=='') no-claim sentinel for missing/empty/whitespace; WriteClaim preserves claimedAt on same-lap re-claim; migrated claim/done/list callers and all store+cmd tests; go build/test clean.

Verified the structured-claim slice against origin/main and the current relay batch, fixed malformed-claim parsing plus file-aware claimedAt preservation, cleaned the event-log lint blockers required for a green lint run, and marked tasks 5.1/5.2/5.5 complete.
